name: Lobe Chat
description: Open-source, modern-design AI chat framework supporting multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq and more), multi-modal input, and a plugin system. This is the lightweight single-container edition for a true one-click private ChatGPT-style application.

env.label: Access Code
env.description: Password that gates access to this Lobe Chat instance. Use a long value to prevent brute-force attacks.

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: OpenAI API key. Can also be set in the UI.

env.label: OpenAI Proxy URL
env.description: Optional. Override the default OpenAI API base URL (e.g. https://api-proxy.com/v1).

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: Anthropic (Claude) API key. Can also be set in the UI.

env.label: Google Gemini API Key
env.description: Google Gemini API key. Can also be set in the UI.

env.label: Groq API Key
env.description: Groq API key. Can also be set in the UI.
